requirements.quote: Register eCourts status and list sources per state in the sources registry and `STATUS_SOURCES` (`packages/core/src/case-watch/lookup.ts`)
route through `packages/fetch` with `delegatedFor` and per-host rate budgets
Acceptance: a watched district matter refreshes through a delegated lookup, with provenance [type:integration].

deliverables.change: Add STATUS_SOURCES entries `in.<st>.district:case_status` for tn, ka, mh, dl, up (template ecourts-district, path case-status); keep the existing Chennai id. No new export.

Add a per-host sliding-window budget keyed `host:<url host>` (default constant, overridable via FetcherDeps), checked with canAcquire alongside the source and advocate checks before any tryAcquire; deny with FetchDenied reason host_rate_limited (add the reason where FetchDenied reasons are declared).

Hand-written migration inserting five uncleared `source` rows (kind court, access_mode A0, max_tier http, base_url https://services.ecourts.gov.in/, low rate_limit_per_minute, notes naming terms to confirm), ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING. Add the matching meta/_journal.json entry and snapshot (copy the previous snapshot, same schema). Use the next free tag if the base took the timestamp.

Add `source.<key>` labels for the new ids (key = id with '.'->'_', see sourceKey) in en, ta, kn case-watch.json, then regenerate generated/messages*, messages.d.ts and translation-status.json with the repo's i18n generator.

Add a test: a watch on a new state district source refreshes through a stub delegated fetcher; assert delegatedFor, stored snapshot provenance (tierUsed, costDollars, sourceRef) and the 5 ids are registered.
Add tests: two sources on one host share the host budget (second denied host_rate_limited, no provider call, no slot spent); different hosts are independent.
Assert the five district case_status rows are seeded uncleared.

preserve.what: runCaseStatusLookup always passes delegatedFor and enforces own-watch scoping (packages/core/src/case-watch/lookup.ts)
Existing Chennai/HC STATUS_SOURCES ids and the sources' fail-closed policy: new rows stay uncleared (packages/core/src/sources/registry.ts)
Existing per-source and per-advocate limits and tier caps in packages/fetch/src/fetcher.ts; apps/web/__tests__/case-watch-actions.test.ts mock list of core exports
